description: Purge cached content for a zone, by file, tag, host, or everything.

files.description: List of URLs whose cached content should be purged.

hosts.description: List of hostnames whose cached content should be purged.

purge_everything.description: Whether to purge all cached content for the zone.

tags.description: List of cache tags whose associated cached content should be purged.

zone_id.description: Identifier of the zone whose cache should be purged.

name: purge_cache
